title: The Continuum Hypothesis
exact_target: Is there a set strictly larger than a countably infinite set and strictly smaller than the real numbers? This particular existence statement is the negation of CH and is independent of ZFC.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1135 (SET-001). CC BY 4.0.

Jesse Michael Han and Floris van Doorn, \emph{A Formal Proof of the Independence of the Continuum Hypothesis}, Proceedings of CPP 2020, 14 pages, Section 1 and the forcing constructions; arXiv:2102.02901.
